prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — editor (n.编辑): An editor sits at a desk reviewing manuscript pages with a red pencil and carefully arranging corrected pages into a folder; no readable writing.
TOP RIGHT — extreme (n.极端): A horizontal scale with a marker at the far right endpoint, center moderate position pale grey; endpoint clearly emphasized blue.
BOTTOM LEFT — statistics (n.统计数字): A clipboard shows three simple bars of different heights alongside rows of small tally strokes, gathered numeric data represented visually.
BOTTOM RIGHT — president (n.总统): A formal national leader stands at a lectern before a plain civic building, two generic flags with geometric shapes; no real likeness or national claims.
review_notes: Reviewed manuscript editor, emphasized endpoint extreme, collected statistical tallies/bars and generic civic president at lectern. No readable text; complete subjects contained in cells.
